inventory_entries_location_requires_ware.name: inventory_entries_location_requires_warehouse
inventory_entries_location_requires_ware.value: "inventory_entries"."warehouse_location_id" IS NULL OR "inventory_entries"."warehouse_id" IS NOT NULL

policy_versions_active_requires_verified.name: policy_versions_active_requires_verified_evidence
policy_versions_active_requires_verified.value: "policy_versions"."status" <> 'ACTIVE' OR ("policy_versions"."evidence_status" = 'VERIFIED' AND "policy_versions"."source_evidence_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "policy_versions"."value" IS NOT NULL AND "policy_versions"."effective_from" IS NOT NULL)

policy_versions_effective_range_valid.name: policy_versions_effective_range_valid
